true_m1_separation.medium_context_champion_status: not crowned: no comparable final SmoothQuant/R054 true-M1 8K/12K/16K curve exists in the audited historical artifacts
true_m1_separation.note: Earlier RTN-line 16K true-M1 points exist, including 15.5019 tok/s on R001 and 17.5621 tok/s on the R193/R224 migration bundle, but those are not the final public SmoothQuant branch and are not used as the no-MTP headline.

selection_rationale: R054 is the latest promoted branch with strong matched repeated medium-context evidence at both 8K and 12K.
The public 0.95 R054 curve supplies a clean 16K MTP5 anchor at 31.9644 tok/s and remains an intact 8K/12K/16K curve.
The actual 0.95 + Prefix Cache deployment profile independently confirms the same 16K performance class at 31.6882 tok/s.
Later fixed-512 winners and isolated-kernel results have no promoted 8K/12K/16K full-model curve and therefore cannot displace R054 for this claim.
Values from different runs are never stitched into a synthetic best-of curve.
